articles.summary: CARMEL, Ind., October 31, 2023 — MBX Biosciences, Inc., a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company developing Precision Endocrine Peptide™ (PEP™) therapeutics to treat an array of endocrine disorders, today announced that Kent Hawryluk, President and Chief Executive Officer, will present at the Stifel 2023 Healthcare Conference on Tuesday, November 14th, 2023, at 2:25 p.m. Eastern Time […]
articles.title: MBX Biosciences to Participate in Stifel 2023 Healthcare Conference
